_comment: Uncork engine catalog: versioned, patched Wine builds (our analogue of Proton-GE versions / CrossOver bottle profiles). Each engine is a base Wine + an ordered patch set, built by build-engine.sh from a recipe. Profiles in compat/profiles.json reference an engine id here; compat/gamefixes.json maps apps to a profile/engine + fixes.
_schema: engines.<id>: { uncork_version, wine_version, crossover_base, source, status, patches[], companion_dxmt_patches[], capabilities[], suits[], notes }
_naming: uncork-<UNCORK_FIX_VERSION>-wine-<WINE_BASE_VERSION>. Bump UNCORK_FIX_VERSION whenever the patch set changes; WINE_BASE_VERSION tracks the upstream/CrossOver Wine version. crossover_base records the exact source tarball.

uncork-1.0-wine-9.0.source: engine/wine-cef (prebuilt bundle; patched components grafted in)
uncork-1.0-wine-9.0.notes: wine-cef. Runs Ubisoft Connect's 32-bit Chromium 135 and renders it via the cross-process IOSurface bridge (DXMT producer + winemac.drv consumer). Shipping. Launch flags: --no-sandbox --disable-direct-composition; WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d11,dxgi,d3d10core=b; DXMT_CROSS_PROCESS_PRESENT=1.

patches: winemac-cross-process/0001-winemac-iosurface-consumer (TODO: not yet ported to this build)
winsock/0001-connect-datagram-port0 (VERIFIED: fixes port-0 connect; EA gRPC needs more)
suits: ea app (partial: EADesktop survives + CEF/GPU spawn; BLOCKED at the localhost BGS gRPC channel which never leaves CONNECTING. NOT a Wine bug - 12 reproducers prove Wine's winsock/IOCP + every resolver path work; the hang is internal to gRPC compiled into EADesktop.exe. Viable EA path = Origin, not the EA app. See wine-fixes/diagnostics/grpc-localhost/)
uncork-1.0-wine-11.0.notes: Full Wine 11 built from CrossOver 26 LGPL source (build-engine.sh). Built at ~/wine-cx-build/cx26-root. Needs OPENSSL_ia32cap=~0x20000000 + WINEDLLOVERRIDES 'mscoree=n;mshtml=' (no wine-mono in the from-source build) + a hosts file with active 'localhost' entries. EA-app gRPC wall is gRPC-internal, not fixable from Wine, see wine-fixes/diagnostics/grpc-localhost/README.md.

wine-stable.notes: The default engine: bundled Wine 11 with DXMT baked in. Steam/Epic/GOG games run here. play.sh forces DXMT builtin + direct-launch + clears stale DXVK overrides.

gptk.notes: Apple Game Porting Toolkit / D3DMetal. Downloaded on demand per compat/profiles.json (gptk / gptk-2.1 / gptk-1.1).

_dist_note: Package with scripts/package-engine.sh → dist/<id>.tar.gz; upload to dist_url_base; fill each engine's download.sha256. App fetches via scripts/ensure-engine-bundle.sh.
